source_id_policy: Stable IDs; entries are primary sources or first-party repository artifacts. No raw captures saved.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox Pattern
sources.version_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG guidance; no page release/version stated.
sources.locator: About this pattern; autocomplete behaviors; Keyboard Interaction.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary W3C pattern page; compared manual-selection, automatic-selection, and Escape/arrow behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Popup is collapsed by default; editable combobox offers manual or automatic list selection; Escape dismisses a visible popup; popup descendants are outside the page Tab sequence.
sources.applicability: Web widget interaction reference only. Helps compare a filter input plus popup, but does not require ARIA in a native desktop app or guarantee AT behavior.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Modal Dialog Pattern
sources.version_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG guidance; no page release/version stated.
sources.locator: Keyboard Interaction; focus placement/return notes; WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary W3C dialog pattern; inspected initial focus, Tab containment, Escape, invoker focus return, and aria-modal conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Focus enters dialog on open, remains in a modal sequence, Escape closes, and returns to invoker unless removed/workflow warrants another destination. Modal semantics require outside interaction to be blocked for all users.
sources.applicability: Supports dismissal and focus-restoration requirements. Editor caret/selection restoration is an additional native-editor state concern.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Listbox Pattern
sources.version_commit: Living WAI-ARIA APG guidance; no page release/version stated.
sources.locator: About; Keyboard Interaction; roles/states/properties and notes.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary W3C pattern; reviewed selection/focus distinction, arrow navigation, option naming, and nested-control limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Single-select listbox focus may optionally follow selection; long option names are spoken as a unit; listbox interaction does not operate nested buttons/links.
sources.applicability: Use to evaluate concise single-action rows and separate focus from invocation; do not pack nested actions into a listbox option.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding Success Criterion 4.1.3 Status Messages
sources.version_commit: WCAG 2.2 supporting Understanding document; living page, no separate page version stated.
sources.observed_operation: Opened W3C guidance and reviewed non-focus status communication and avoiding unnecessary interruption.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Status changes that do not receive focus should be programmatically determinable for AT; intent includes informing without unnecessarily interrupting.
sources.applicability: Supports concise polite result/status announcements. It does not set an exact debounce interval or guarantee a particular screen-reader utterance.

sources.title: Microsoft Accessibility Best Practices
sources.version_commit: Microsoft Learn living documentation; no toolkit release stated.
sources.locator: Programmatic Access; Keyboard Navigation; Multi-modal Interface.
sources.observed_operation: Opened Windows guidance on accessible names/properties/events, keyboard focus, and color alternatives.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: All UI elements need accessible labels, property values, and appropriate events; visible keyboard focus is needed; color should not convey information alone.
sources.applicability: Windows/UI Automation requirements inform platform checks. This is not evidence about Linux or a guarantee of usable screen-reader interaction.

sources.title: Microsoft UI Automation Control Types Overview
sources.version_commit: Microsoft Learn living documentation; page states last updated 2025-07-14.
sources.locator: UI Automation Control Type Requisites; LocalizedControlType Property.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary UIA control-type overview; reviewed required control patterns, properties, events, and tree structure.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A predefined control type has required properties/patterns/events/tree conditions; use custom control type and concise localized type when those conditions are not met.
sources.applicability: Supports testing actual exposed Windows semantics rather than choosing a role by appearance. It does not choose combobox vs dialog for this product.

sources.title: GNOME AT-SPI Accessibility Architecture
sources.version_commit: AT-SPI2 docs; related libatspi API page identifies library 2.62.0.1, API 2.0.
sources.locator: Screen readers and other Assistive Technologies; Toolkit integration.
sources.observed_operation: Opened GNOME's primary accessibility-stack guide; traced toolkit exposure through AT-SPI/DBus to Orca and other ATs.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Toolkits translate controls into AT-SPI concepts; Orca consumes accessible names/actions and navigates focus; modern toolkits may connect directly rather than through ATK.
sources.applicability: Justifies a separate Linux AT-SPI/Orca check; the stack is distinct from Windows UIA and behavior must be tested end to end.

sources.title: VS Code 1.137.0 command palette provider
sources.version_commit: VS Code 1.137.0 release snapshot; commit 645f29cc3176500b4b5762ba887cf2a7f0ffdf2c (release tag points to 645f29c).
sources.observed_operation: Read provider setup, the one-time extension registration race, global command construction, action filtering, and palette keybindings.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Waits for extension registration or 800 ms once; obtains editor/global picks; global actions are filtered to enabled MenuItemAction entries; category prefixes label; Show All Commands uses Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P except Firefox and F1 secondary.
sources.applicability: Comparative implementation only. Enabled-only filtering cannot explain relevant unavailable actions; no explicit live add/remove subscription was found in this provider, which does not prove behavior of lower layers.

sources.title: VS Code 1.137.0 command quick-input model and search
sources.observed_operation: Read command pick data fields, match/rank/disambiguate flow, keybinding accessibility label, and accept handler.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Matches label/alias by contiguous substring or word matcher; exact ID match; for query length >=3, TF-IDF fallback threshold 0.5 and max five; duplicate labels expose command IDs; MRU then name sort; execution is in accept callback.
sources.applicability: Useful code and trade-off evidence for search and stable IDs. IDs are not human-readable scope; this implementation is not a typo-tolerance guarantee.

sources.title: VS Code 1.137.0 quick-access tests
sources.locator: Provider registry and when-condition tests; provider cancellation tests; PickerEditorState test at lines 1948-2019.
sources.observed_operation: Read tests for context-gated quick-access providers, cancellation/disposal on provider changes, and restoring active editor/selection after transient editors.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Provider visibility follows when context; replacing active provider cancels/disposes prior provider; editor restoration test verifies active resource/order and editor selection.
sources.applicability: A test pattern for keyboard/controller state. It does not test command palette AT behavior, live extension command additions/removals, or scroll restoration.

sources.title: VS Code issue #268450: command missing from palette
sources.locator: Issue summary and referenced precondition in chatSetup.ts.
sources.observed_operation: Read user report that a discoverability command was absent because setup-state preconditions excluded the already-installed case.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Command had a restrictive precondition based on setup state; issue was fixed by widening that condition.
sources.applicability: Concrete history for hidden conditional commands; supports explicit visibility policy and regression test.

sources.title: VS Code PR #268462
sources.version_commit: Merged into VS Code main on 2025-10-22; merge commit 0734942.
sources.locator: PR overview, merge record, issue linkage.
sources.observed_operation: Read PR description and merge status; it removes a restrictive precondition to show Learn How to Hide AI Features in more situations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Changes visibility predicate to only require that chat setup is not already hidden.
sources.applicability: Issue-to-fix evidence that visibility gating can remove useful command discovery.

sources.version_commit: Current master branch; package version 1.13.2 per S15; exact Git commit UNKNOWN in this capture.

sources.title: Fuse.js fuzzy-search guide
sources.locator: Bitap description; threshold/location/distance defaults and example.
sources.observed_operation: Read primary library documentation for approximate search and threshold/location tuning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default threshold 0.6, location 0, distance 100; effective default window approx. 60 characters from location; ignoreLocation disables location scoring.
sources.applicability: Search-alternative evidence only; default configuration should not be adopted without testing short command labels and long descriptions.

sources.version_commit: Current product documentation; no specific release/version stated.
sources.locator: Keyboard navigation; Screen readers; input/results navigation.
